hooks.text: 击败怪物收集能量，再用能量开启地图宝箱找装备，强化后进入下一波战斗
hooks.excerpt: Beat cute yet silly mobs → Collect energy → Explore the map (hunt for gear) → Brawl with the next wave of cute creeps! Earn energy by defeating monsters to unlock in-map treasure chests, gain gear, boost your combat power, stop the evil Dimensional Reaper "Chaos", and restore cosmic order.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 法师、棒球手、狼人、机甲枪手和弓手拥有专属技能与被动，跨技能合理搭配可触发华丽高伤连招
hooks.excerpt: The game features a variety of characters with unique mechanics and traits for you to choose from! Mage: Master of powerful control magic Baseball Player: Swing with courage and strength Werewolf: Unleash primal fury and bloodthirsty instincts Mecha Warrior (Gunner): Wield heavy firepower Archer: Agile, graceful, and never misses a shot Each character boasts exclusive powerful skills and passive effects. Their skills can form clever synergies—rational combinations unlock gorgeous combos and devastating damage output!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用受损能量阵列碎片锻造支援伙伴，包括进攻Armed Cat、治疗Little Dragon和探索辅助Huaihuai
hooks.excerpt: Companion System: Immense vitality lies within the damaged energy arrays. Use shards of these arrays to forge your ultimate supportive allies—Offensive "Armed Cat", Healing "Little Dragon", and Exploration Support "Huaihuai"!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
